versions.content: The Dem shall provide the ability to access the non-volatile stored Permanent DTC by filtering for permanent DTCs to the Dcm (refer to Dem_SetDTCFil- ter and Dem_GetNextFilteredDTC ).
The Dem shall provide the ability to access the non-volatile stored Permanent DTC by filtering for permanent DTCs to the Dcm (refer to Dem_SetDTCFil- ter and Dem_GetNextFilteredDTC ).
Reporting stored permanent DTCs On a set DTC filter via Dem_SetDTCFilter and DTCOrigin = DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PERMANENT_MEMORY , the Dem shall report in Dem_GetNextFilteredDTC the stored permanent DTCs.
